title: Nextera XT DNA Library Prep Kit Protocol: Part 3/4 - Normalize Libraries
author: Opentrons
materials: of the overall workflow: normalize libraries. This step normalizes the concentration of each library to ensure correct library representation in the donwstream pooled libraries. It is safe to stop after this step and re-start work at a later point. If you are stopping, seal the plate and store at -25°C to -15°C for up to seven days. -- To purchase tips, reagents, or pipettes, please visit our [online store](https://shop.opentrons.com/) or contact our sales team at [info@opentrons.com](mailto:info@opentrons.com) * [Opentrons OT-2](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-robot/products/ot-2) * [Opentrons OT-2 Run App (Version 3.15.0 or later)](https://opentrons.com/ot-app/) * [Opentrons P300 or P50 Pipette (Single or 8-Channel)](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-pipettes) and corresponding [Tips](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/opentrons-300ul-tips) * [Opentrons Magnetic Module](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/hardware-modules/products/magdeck) * [Bio-Rad 96-Well Plate, 200μl](https://labware.opentrons.com/biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr) containing samples from [Part 1](http:/
Make sure to add reagents to your labware before placing it on the deck! Your reagents should be in your reservoir, and the samples you’re starting with should be in your plate in slot 5 on the deck.

steps.title: Gather required equipment
steps.instruction: Collect all hardware and consumables listed for the Nextera XT normalization run.

substeps.instruction: Opentrons OT‑2 Run App (Version 3.15.0 or later)
Opentrons P300 or P50 pipette (single‑channel or 8‑channel) with compatible tips
Sealing film or caps for the plate

steps.title: Seal plate if stopping
steps.instruction: If you stop after this normalization step, seal the plate and store it at –25 °C to –15 °C for up to seven days.

steps.title: Select desired settings
steps.instruction: In the “Setup” section of the protocol, choose all desired options to customize the OT‑2 run.

steps.title: Download customized protocol
steps.instruction: Click the blue “Download” button above the deck map to obtain the customized OT‑2 Python protocol file.

steps.title: Upload protocol to Opentrons App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file into the Opentrons App, then follow the on‑screen instructions to set up the deck, calibrate labware, and start the run.

steps.title: Add reagents to labware
steps.instruction: Place all required reagents in the reservoir and load the sample plate (containing the libraries from Part 1) into slot 5 of the deck before starting the robot.
